code_paths.purpose: Handles the wallet_propose RPC command, generating a wallet from user-supplied or random seed/passphrase/key_type.

flow: used to select key type for generateKeyPair
If not libSeed, passed to RPC::getSeedFromRPC if present
transformations: If not, used as passphrase for seed derivation

flow: If not libSeed, passed to RPC::getSeedFromRPC if present
transformations: If not, used as seed for key derivation

flow: walletPropose: passed to RPC::getSeedFromRPC if present
All field validations and extractions occur here

description: Implements the walletPropose RPC handler for generating XRPL wallet keys, including entropy estimation for passphrases and support for different key types and seed formats.
